# Telebrief

> Telebrief is a self-hosted, open-source (MIT) service that reads the Telegram channels and groups you choose, summarizes them with an LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic or local Ollama), and sends you a daily digest through your own Telegram bot. It also exposes digests and raw channel messages to AI agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Telebrief runs as a single Docker container (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64) published at `ghcr.io/belaytzev/telebrief`. It logs in to Telegram with your own user account (Telethon), so it can read private channels and groups you are a member of. It is single-user by design.

## Getting started

- [Quick Start](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief#-quick-start): run `docker run --rm -it --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/setup ghcr.io/belaytzev/telebrief python main.py init /setup` in an empty directory, then `docker compose up -d`. The wizard logs in to Telegram, checks the bot token, lets you pick channels and writes `.env`, `config.yaml`, `docker-compose.yml` and the session file.
- [Prerequisites](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief#-prerequisites): Docker, Telegram `api_id`/`api_hash` from my.telegram.org, a bot token from @BotFather, and an API key for OpenAI or Anthropic (not needed for Ollama).
- [Full configuration reference](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief/blob/main/config.yaml.example): schedule, timezone, lookback window, AI provider and model, output language, digest mode, filters, storage and MCP settings.

## Features

- [Digest modes](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief#-example-output): group summaries by channel (default) or by AI-detected topics, with optional cross-channel deduplication.
- [Per-channel configuration](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief#%EF%B8%8F-per-channel-configuration): per-channel lookback window and extra prompt instructions.
- [Persistent storage](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief#%EF%B8%8F-persistent-storage): optional SQLite or PostgreSQL store of raw collected messages.
- [Extensibility](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief#-extensibility): message filters (keyword, regex, minimum length), custom prompt templates and composers.
- Bot commands: `/digest` (generate now), `/status`, `/cleanup`, `/help`.
- Output languages: English, Russian, Spanish, German, French.

## MCP server

- [MCP documentation](https://github.com/belaytzev/Telebrief#-mcp-server): streamable HTTP endpoint inside the running service (`mcp.enabled: true`, default `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp`), or stdio via `python main.py mcp`.
- Tools: `get_digest(hours)` builds a fresh digest (`hours=168` for a weekly one), `get_last_digest()` returns the cached one, `get_channel_messages(channel, hours, limit)` returns raw messages of one configured channel, `search_messages(query, channel, days, limit)` searches the configured channels' full history via Telegram search.
- The MCP server has no authentication: keep it on loopback or behind a firewall.
